title: Consolidated Org Billing: cross-subscription proration and delegated credits
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Large customers often run multiple Redwood orgs (per-product or per-business-unit). Finance teams want a single consolidated invoice but also expect accurate per-subscription chargebacks, mid-cycle plan changes, and delegated credits from parent orgs to children. Current metering produces per-org invoices with no built-in consolidation or automated inter-subscription proration, causing manual spreadsheets and delayed refunds.
goal: Create an automated consolidated-billing flow that: 1) emits a single monthly invoice for a set of linked orgs; 2) computes per-subscription chargebacks with accurate mid-cycle proration; 3) supports parent->child delegated credits and auto-application rules; 4) produces auditable ledger entries for finance and SSO-protected customer security questionnaires.
acceptance_criteria: Consolidated invoice PDF and machine-readable line items for a linked-org group (parent + children) generated and viewable in Console
Per-subscription chargebacks computed with time-weighted proration when plan or seat changes occur mid-cycle
Delegated credits can be issued by parent org and either auto-applied to child usage or retained on parent balance based on rule configuration
Audit trail: every credit/adjustment has origin, author (email), GitHub PR reference or support ticket, and is queryable by date range
No more than 2% difference between simulated spreadsheet reconciliation and automated ledger in our test customers across 3 scenarios: downgrade, org split, and delegated credit revocation
out_of_scope: Real-time per-token reallocation between orgs during request time; cross-cloud provider billing federation (will integrate later).
updates: 2025-01-10 - Created ticket after discovery call with AcmeCorp finance; flagged as enterprise pain with manual reconciliation taking 3+ days
2025-01-16 - Spike complete (ENG-6723): measured current metering artifacts; identified missing timestamped ledger entries causing ambiguity for mid-cycle changes
2025-01-22 - PM/DX sync: Console needs a consolidated billing view and an API endpoint for ledger exports. UX proto drafted (Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/consolidated-billing-proto)
2025-01-29 - Design review: CFO-mode in Console will surface per-org allocations and allow parents to configure 'auto-apply credits' or 'hold on parent balance'

2025-02-02 - ENG estimation: backend work split into 3 PRs; schema change to invoice-line model proposed (GH PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8123). Plan for staged rollout behind feature flag.
2025-02-05 - Legal/Cust Ops feedback: require enhanced audit metadata for security questionnaires. Added audit fields to acceptance criteria and flagged as high customer impact
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Incorrect proration math for complex seat-change windows could lead to customer-facing invoice disputes. Mitigation: run reconciliation harness against historical invoices for 6 pilot customers and require <1% delta before rollout.

Risk: Delegated credits applied incorrectly across currency boundaries. Mitigation: initial MVP restricts delegated-credits to same-currency linked orgs and flags cross-currency cases for manual review.
Risk: Audit metadata may expose internal emails. Mitigation: sanitize display and require role-based Console permissions to view full audit provenance.
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal pilot with 3 accounts (finance+platform leads) behind feature flag - verify ledger exports and PDF formatting
Beta: invite 10 customers for opt-in testing; provide CSV/GL exports and IFRS-friendly line items
GA: enable for all enterprise accounts with opt-in for legacy customers; notify customers 30 days before auto-enabling
metrics_and_success_criteria: Time-to-reconcile (manual) reduced from 3 days to <4 hours for pilot customers
Number of billing disputes tied to proration errors <= 1 per 1,000 invoices during beta
Adoption: 50% of invited beta customers opt into consolidated billing within 60 days
notes_for_engineering: Modify meter pipeline to emit timestamped 'effective_period' fields for each usage record (start, end) and attach subscription_id and org_group_id
Invoice line model change must remain backward-compatible; add new 'allocation_parent' and 'allocation_method' fields with default 'per-subscription-split'
Provide ledger export API: /v1/billing/ledger?org_group_id=<>&start=<>&end=<> -> returns CSV + JSONL (audit metadata included)

'We need delegated credits so the parent legal entity can centrally manage cost centers' - Finance lead, Beta customer
